# Dub

Short link management platform with analytics and API for creating, managing, and tracking branded short links

Category: Marketing. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/dub/.

## Actions

- **Bulk Update Links**: Update multiple short links in bulk.
- **Create Domain**: Add a domain to a Dub workspace.
- **Create Tag**: Create a new tag in Dub.
- **Get Link Info** (read-only): Retrieve details of a specific short link from Dub.
- **Get Links** (read-only): Retrieve a paginated list of links for the authenticated workspace.
- **Get Workspace** (read-only): Retrieve detailed information for a specific workspace.
- **List Domains** (read-only): Retrieve a list of domains for the authenticated workspace.
- **Retrieve List of Tags** (read-only): Retrieve a list of tags from Dub.
- **Update Domain**: Update a domain configuration in Dub.
- **Upsert a Link**: Create or update a short link in Dub.
- **Bulk Delete Links**: Delete multiple short links in bulk from Dub.
- **Delete Domain**: Delete a domain from your Dub workspace.
- **Delete Tag**: Delete a tag from Dub.
- **Get Links Count** (read-only): Retrieve the count of links in workspace with optional filters.
- **Track Deep Link Open Event**: Track a deep link open event in Dub.
- **Update Tag**: Update an existing tag by ID.
- **Update Workspace**: Update workspace settings in Dub.
